nodes.summary: In an empty outer context, restriction exposes exactly its two peers.
nodes.title: Restriction binding over the empty map

nodes.summary: A restriction binds one physical name and creates its two distinct linear roles. Lifted outer keys cannot be overwritten by these insertions.
nodes.title: Binding a fresh dual pair under restriction

nodes.summary: The exact restriction context has two fresh entries plus all shifted outer ownership. No old entry is overwritten by a new endpoint role.
nodes.title: Entries of a restriction-bound ownership map

nodes.summary: An absent outer key remains absent after adding the fresh bound dual pair.
nodes.title: Restriction binding preserves absence of an outer key

nodes.summary: Lifting preserves absence of an outer role from its finite context.
nodes.title: Lifting preserves absence of a key

nodes.summary: Both roles of the newly inserted name are fresh for the lifted context.
nodes.title: Both roles of the new name are fresh for a lifted map

nodes.summary: Inserting a binder does not manufacture an outer capability.
nodes.title: Lifting the empty ownership map

nodes.summary: Lifting a single capability shifts its name, not its protocol or role.
nodes.title: Lifting a singleton ownership map

nodes.summary: Insert an ambient name binder at any cutoff in an ownership context.
nodes.title: Lifting an ownership map past a binder

nodes.summary: The same restriction installs the negative peer at the SAME name.
nodes.title: Negative role lookup after restriction binding

nodes.summary: Restriction installs the positive capability without losing it to the opposite role's insertion.
nodes.title: Positive role lookup after restriction binding

nodes.summary: Lifting keeps the entire capability at the corresponding lifted key.
nodes.title: Lookups in a lifted ownership map

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
